_: Shared input for tools/route-parity.mjs and tests/test_diagram_svg.py. Synthetic; coordinates follow db.LAYOUT_COL_W/ROW_H so the collisions are the kind a real arrangement produces.
_covers: every shape: start, step, decision, io, end
a fork whose two arrows leave the same side of one card (fan + funnel)
an A->B / B->A pair, which fans rather than detours
a loop closer running back up the page (dashed, and possibly a lane)
a long forward edge that would cross two cards (detour or corridor)
a short back edge between stacked cards (hop in its own column)
two nodes sized by hand, so node_size takes both branches
a step unreachable from start, so orphan_keys is exercised

jumps both ways: 'audit' carries them without any link, so the lower badge row stands on its own, 'check' carries one of each, and a keyless incoming jump aimed at the diagram as a whole belongs to no card and is counted on none

TWO edges that fit nowhere between their ends, so they take margin lanes -- the wide 'guard'/'gate' cards and the 'wall_left'/'wall_right' pair exist to block every nearer corridor, and two such edges so the side alternates and the second lane stacks outward
_walls: wall_left/wall_right have no edges: they are there to close the last corridors on the full-height column, which is what makes an edge run out of candidates and take a margin lane. They leave a gap around x=0 so the spine itself is untouched. Widen the gap and the lane coverage silently disappears -- see test_the_fixture_exercises_every_routing_branch.
